newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Smugglers leave German-bound migrants in Hungary.
newsitem.headline: Smugglers leave German-bound migrants in Hungary.

text.p: Hungarian border guards have detained eight illegal migrants who had been told by smugglers they were in Germany, the Hungarian news agency MTI said on Thursday.

The migrants, four from Iraq, two from Algeria and two from Libya, were found hiding in a ditch near the Hegyeshalom border crossing to Austria on Wednesday night clad in light clothing despite freezing temperatures.
They told the border guards they had arrived from Turkey where they had paid $1,500 each to smugglers who promised to take them to Germany hidden in a truck. @
A few days ago, 11 Turkish and Lebanese were also picked up by border guards after being abandoned by smugglers who told them they were in Germany.
